title: Concept: Dependency fetched over the unauthenticated git protocol
description: package.json declares a dependency URL that uses the `git://` protocol, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The git protocol carries no transport authentication for the fetched objects, so a network attacker can substitute the tree the install compiles.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The git protocol carries no transport authentication for the fetched objects, so a network attacker can substitute the tree the install compiles.
